jobs.title: Photocopier jams on every page
jobs.description: The big Canon copier on the 2nd floor jams on every page and shows a fuser error.

jobs.title: Copier prints with black lines
jobs.description: Our Ricoh photocopier prints black lines down every page after the drum change.

jobs.title: Receipt printer prints blank
jobs.description: The thermal receipt printer at the till prints blank slips.

jobs.title: LaserJet offline on the network
jobs.description: Our HP LaserJet shows offline for everyone on the office network.

jobs.title: Weak Wi-Fi on the 3rd floor
jobs.description: Wi-Fi keeps dropping on the 3rd floor meeting rooms; we need better coverage.

jobs.title: New office needs Wi-Fi
jobs.description: Set up Wi-Fi access points and cabling for our new 20-desk office.

jobs.title: Fibre link down after road work
jobs.description: Our fibre internet line was cut during road work outside the branch.

jobs.title: Branch VPN not connecting
jobs.description: The branch VPN tunnel to head office won't come up after the router reset.

jobs.title: NVR not recording
jobs.description: Our NVR stopped recording two of the IP cameras last night.

jobs.title: Install 6 IP cameras
jobs.description: We need 6 new IP cameras installed around the warehouse with an NVR.

jobs.title: Vault camera tamper alarm
jobs.description: The camera inside the branch vault keeps raising a tamper alarm.

jobs.title: Split AC leaking water
jobs.description: The split AC in the manager's room is leaking water onto the floor.

jobs.title: AC needs gas refill
jobs.description: Our office split AC blows warm air; it probably needs a gas refill.

jobs.title: Server room overheating
jobs.description: Server room temperature is 32 degrees; the precision cooling unit has stopped.

jobs.title: ATM not dispensing cash
jobs.description: The ATM debits customers but doesn't dispense cash; probably a cassette jam.

jobs.title: ATM cash jam
jobs.description: Notes are stuck in the ATM's dispenser at the Banani booth.

jobs.title: ATM eats cards
jobs.description: The ATM card reader keeps retaining customers' cards.

jobs.title: Sockets not working
jobs.description: Half the sockets in the open office stopped working after a short circuit.

jobs.title: Tripping breaker
jobs.description: The main breaker in our office distribution board trips every afternoon.

jobs.title: Factory motor won't start
jobs.description: A three-phase motor on the sewing line won't start; the panel shows a phase fault.

jobs.title: Generator won't take over
jobs.description: During load shedding the generator starts but the changeover switch doesn't switch.

jobs.title: Generator service due
jobs.description: Our 60 kVA diesel generator needs its 500-hour service.

jobs.title: Card machine declines everything
jobs.description: Our Verifone card machine declines every card with a communication error.

jobs.title: Payment terminal frozen
jobs.description: The Ingenico payment terminal at counter 3 is frozen on the logo.

jobs.title: Solar inverter error
jobs.description: Our rooftop solar inverter shows a grid fault and stopped producing.

jobs.title: Install rooftop solar
jobs.description: We want 10 kW of rooftop solar with batteries on the warehouse.

jobs.title: Door reader not unlocking
jobs.description: The card reader on the main door doesn't unlock for anyone since this morning.

jobs.title: Attendance machine not syncing
jobs.description: Our fingerprint attendance machine stopped syncing with the HR software.

jobs.title: Label printer smudges
jobs.description: The label printer at the warehouse dispatch desk prints smudged barcodes.

jobs.title: LaserJet toner streaks
jobs.description: Our HP LaserJet leaves toner streaks after the new cartridge.
